intro.title: Ask AI
intro.subtitle: A natural-language agent over a 50-module / 500-action CRM
intro.narration: Ask AI turns plain English into real C R M actions, across fifty modules and five hundred actions. Here is a live walkthrough.

outro.title: Ask AI
outro.subtitle: +19pp over baseline · prompt caching cut cost ~74% · all 50 modules covered
outro.narration: In the benchmark, the optimized agent beats the baseline by nineteen points, and prompt caching cut cost by about seventy four percent. That's Ask AI.

clips.title: A single named action, executed
clips.subtitle: Search + aggregate, answered in seconds
clips.narration: A direct request. The agent searches opportunities and aggregates the total in one pass.

clips.title: No action named — the agent infers intent
clips.subtitle: Infers "at-risk", investigates across the pipeline
clips.narration: An indirect request. No action is named, so the agent infers what at-risk means and investigates across the pipeline.

clips.title: Three modules, one aggregate confirmation
clips.subtitle: Opportunity · Task · Note
clips.narration: A complex workflow across three modules — it creates an opportunity, a task, and a note, behind a single confirmation.

clips.title: Context carried across turns
clips.subtitle: "the top one" resolves from the prior turn
clips.narration: A follow-up that builds on the last answer. First it lists the biggest open deals. Then — who owns the top one, and when does it close — resolved entirely from the previous turn's context.

clips.title: Asks instead of guessing
clips.subtitle: A focused clarifying question
clips.narration: When a request is ambiguous, the agent asks one focused question instead of guessing.

clips.title: No fabrication on errors
clips.subtitle: Reports what it couldn't find
clips.narration: And when something doesn't exist, it says so honestly instead of pretending it worked.

clips.title: Files in, rich answers out
clips.subtitle: Attach a file · tables become charts · clickable records
clips.narration: Attach a file, and the agent reads it — here it summarizes call notes and flags the single next step. Answers come back as rich tables and bar charts, not walls of text. And every record is a clickable chip that opens its full detail inline.

clips.title: Role-aware capabilities
clips.subtitle: A viewer can read, never write
clips.narration: Permissions are role-aware. As a viewer, the agent can read, but write and delete tools are never even available to it.

clips.title: Remembers across sessions
clips.subtitle: Teach it once · it recalls in a new chat
clips.narration: Tell it something once. The trace shows the memory being saved, and it lands on your memories page. Then, in a brand new conversation, it recalls your quarterly target — and answers in the bulleted style you asked for.
